about: Road distance (km, minutes) of every Health Centre to the nearest Hospital (hospital = provider id; null = no road connection, then air_km / air_hospital = nearest in a straight line), with its regional unit, municipality and municipal unit, the capital of its regional unit when it is in that town (capital) and the urban area it is in (urban). Roads only, no ferries. Made by scripts/access/compute_hc_hospitals.py; served by GET /access/health-centres.
